visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Pyramid Leans to One Side
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The shape should be a symmetric pyramid, but every row has one star more than the row before, so it leans to the right.

solution.explanation: A centered pyramid grows by two stars per row (1, 3, 5, 7), which is 2 * i - 1. Growing by one star (k < i) makes a right triangle that no longer lines up with the leading spaces.
